'''Pabel Alde''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of [[House Alde]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. At one point she suffered injures in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] crash on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The foragers of [[Oroboro]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] found her and brought her into the nest. They healed her, but she became a [[Joiner]] in process.
